changes.title: Keep Android Back usable until its system callback actually delivers
changes.text: Retain the registered Android callback and the last-known-working GDX Back fallback. Callback registration alone no longer disables Back. When the system callback actually accepts a press, exactly its one delayed legacy copy is suppressed, including the observed API36 356ms copy. Activity ownership fencing and original same-route timing remain.

changes.title: Preserve the repeated six-profile failure and verify delivered-callback deduplication
changes.text: Retain both rejected TEST337 display matrices and the incomplete API34 result. Expanded guards distinguish callback registration from actual delivery, require one-token delayed-copy suppression and preserve fallback, ownership and reset behavior. The complete 2216-method core rerun is green; all native, display, UIMSD latency, identity, signature, checksum and history gates still remain mandatory.

commentary: Compare the immediate compiled rejected TEST337, not older published TEST330. Preserve all363 prior matching history TSVs and append only this record. TEST337 failed the returned-title assertion on its original six profiles, its API34 run, and a second six-profile exact-APK fixture rerun; the latter changed no application source and disproved the injection-only hypothesis. TEST335's 341ms UIMSD latency failure remains disclosed. No physical-phone acceptance, public release or tester auto-distribution is claimed.
